shellBehavior: A redirection before the command is valid shell: stdin is read from file 'in' and npm install evil-pkg runs. findCommandTokenIndex() stops at the '<' redirection token and reports it as the command position, so the install is missed.
note: findCommandTokenIndex() skips env-assignments and wrappers but not leading redirection operators + their targets. A ~5-line skip of REDIRECTION_OPERATORS tokens (and one target token) there would likely close it, but it changes a security-critical shared function and needs full regression validation, so it is deferred to the decomposition phase.
